semantic.justification: Original file_url.cxx first-use charset singleton conversion, strict decodeFromUtf8 escaped-octet handling, chunked conversion, native EOVERFLOW wrappers and convertPathnameToUrl over original RTL URI owners are ported. OStringBuffer consumed constructors/copy/view assignment/reservation/append/remove/direct length/value-clear semantics use existing SAL C buffer owners; physical JS storage remains GC-managed. Both modern test_ostringbuffer.cxx tests and real UTF8/ASCII/error/large-chunk scenarios execute. Full legacy OStringBuffer QA/scalar/lazy/move surface and complete URL/home/authority/open/temp/package/model/UI acceptance remain unfinished; native ABI/OOM/uninitialized/thread/shutdown and debug diagnostics are unqualified. All6 legacy constructor cases, all8 makeStringAndClear cases and remove_001 are now ported from sal/qa/OStringBuffer/rtl_OStringBuffer.cxx, alongside both modern tests. Remaining legacy capacity/length/scalar/insert families are not claimed complete. Complete legacy getLength8/getCapacity10/ensureCapacity12/setLength22/csuc2/getStr2 and counted-pointer append20 cases now execute original pinned expectations. The extractor reads only source CppUnit/header literals, verifies registration/case/assertion sets and SHA-256, never production code or test results. Original non-null pointer assertion before C insertion and explicit counted append overload are restored; appendUninitialized remains the reservation path. Other legacy scalar/lazy/move/append families and native ABI/uninitialized/OOM remain unfinished or unqualified.
